body.statement: For a circuit return and a fixed stratum \(S\), \(\Pr_p(\widehat p_N\in\mathcal U)\to1\). On the event \(\widehat p_N\in\mathcal U\), the total definitions coincide with \(\widehat Q_N=\widetilde F_S(\widehat p_N)\) and the Jacobian plug-in covariance. Consequently, without conditioning, \(\sqrt N\{\widehat Q_N-\operatorname{Eval}(F,p)\}\) converges to \(\mathcal N(0,\Sigma_F(p))\), with influence vector \(\psi_p(O_i)=J_F(p)(e_{O_i}-p)\); \(\widehat\Sigma_F\) is consistent, its rank equals \(r\) with probability tending to one, and \(\mathcal W_N\) has asymptotic coverage \(1-\alpha\) within the range of \(\Sigma_F(p)\).
body.justification: A graphically identified circuit becomes empirically useful only after its branchwise sampling law and covariance are explicit.
body.gap: BhattacharyaNabiShpitser2022Semiparametric derives influence estimators for one fixed graphical functional, not a circuit compiled across observable-model overlaps.
body.consumer: The ALARM analysis obtains automatic-differentiation standard errors for every reported macro outcome coordinate on a certified regular stratum.
